Feature Overview
For developers building and operating AI agents across development and operational workflows, Datadog offers two solutions for accessing live observability data within AI-driven experiences: Pup CLI for scripting, automation, shell-style agents, and high-scale custom agent workflows; and MCP Server for in-chat AI agents and AI-powered IDE experiences.
